about_the_game:
"KaiKi" is a walking simulator and visual novel game in which you walk along the beach, taking photos and gradually recalling precious memories.

Story

It's the summer 12 years since his wife's death. A man visits the sea of his memories.

He walks along the beach, carrying the camera he once used to watch the ocean with.

Even if the waves wash away his footprints, he takes each step with determination.

Game Content

This is a first-person adventure game in which you walk along the beach and take photos.

By photographing objects that are memorable to the protagonist, you will reminisce about those memories in novel format.

Head to your destination on the other side of the beach, and the ending will branch out depending on the number of memories you have.

Number of Endings: 2

Controls

Movement: WASD

Action: E

Menu: Q

Text forwarding: Space bar

Video streaming

・Streaming is possible without permission from individuals or corporations.

・Monetization is only possible if you use the functions provided by the video streaming site.

・We would appreciate it if you could include the name of the game in the title of your video or stream, and include a link to the Steam page in the description section or elsewhere. (This is optional.)

We are not responsible for any damages caused by streaming videos of this game.

The contents of this guideline may change without notice.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of violence and grotesque depictions.
